checks.falsifier: a binding names a material absent from data/display/materials.json
checks.soWhat: an unresolved binding renders as a hole in the ground on every phone

checks.claim: every shipped material carries an allowed license with provenance
checks.falsifier: a ledger row carries a license outside the allowed set
checks.soWhat: license before embed — an AGPL texture in the bundle is a shipping bug

checks.claim: the spec carries no coordinates — skins restyle, never reposition
checks.evidence: no lat/lng/ring keys anywhere in the spec
checks.falsifier: any lat, lng, or ring key appears anywhere in the spec
checks.soWhat: a display file that can move a Place breaks the truth/display split

checks.claim: every styled land exists in truth geometry

checks.soWhat: styling a district that does not exist means a tint silently never draws

checks.falsifier: a spec or bound material exceeds the phone budget
